confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are central estimates from Berlin cost guides and Numbeo-based averages in search results; sources mix dates and user-reported data. Cocktail and wine ranges are wide, and mid-range two-person meal sources span roughly 40 to 75 EUR with unclear drink treatment. Beer assumes a 0.5 L glass. EUR figures use an assumed 1.15 USD per EUR, not a searched rate. Accommodation anchors are general-knowledge July peak-season estimates, not checked against live listings. FX is the latest RBA-page observation surfaced by search (2026-03-20), about eight months before the 2026-11-19 generation date; a later third-party-reported figure (2026-10-27) could not be verified on rba.gov.au and was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city substitution. Food and drink anchors rely on Berlin-specific cost guides and Numbeo-based averages; accommodation anchors reflect general knowledge of Berlin's summer hostel and hotel tiers.
